name: Caster
source:
One of the 16 playable servants in Fate/Extella.

[spoiler]Caster's True Name is Archimedes, a "celebrated genius in human history." A mathematician ahead of his time. He is the main antagonist of Fate/Extella. His Noble Phantasm is Katoptron Katho Phlegon.[/spoiler]
